main_idea: BAR measures end-to-end legal work and informs improvements to Legora’s harness.
ideas: BAR covers thousands of legal cases across practice areas.
BAR-informed harness changes improved output quality by 5% in one month.
summary: A stats row, practice-area grid, explanatory copy, and footer compete for attention; the 5% result lacks a defined metric and comparison.

missing.why: The 5% improvement lacks a baseline or comparison condition.
The graphic gives no definition or unit for output quality.
It does not identify which production models improved.
